findings: CSS focus-within loses some nested top-layer ancestry; composed-tree ownership fixes premature parent dismissal.
Closing focus moves before the surface becomes inert. Existing application dialog focus is retained.
The shared semantic controller owns item label/description references; direct rendered attributes were cleared. Chromium AX verifies separate name and description.
Clear the current item when fully closed so reopening on the same item restores its visible highlight.
WebKit plain native buttons reproduce the platform Tab preference; native text fields prove menu Tab departure.
The token-count assertion rises from 443 to 446 for the three actual shadow keys; key uniqueness and source checks remain.
